# Lone Larsen

Lone Larsen is chair of the steering group for [[danibd|DANIBD]] (Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme), Denmark's national quality database for inflammatory bowel disease. She holds the rank of attending physician (overlæge), holds a Ph.D., and serves as a clinical lecturer. In this role, she signs the annual report on behalf of the steering group [^src1] [^src2] [^src3] [^src4].

Larsen works in [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] (North Denmark Region) [^src2] [^src5]. Her formal titles appear consistently across DANIBD's annual reports for 2023 and 2024, establishing her as a key clinical and research leader in the governance of Denmark's IBD quality monitoring system. The steering group she chairs comprises representatives from medicine, surgery, nursing, and patient representation across all Danish regions, along with epidemiological and data management support from RKKP (Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram, the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme) [^src6].
